person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index supplies William G. Carr in Box 109 without a rank or restricted identifier. Official, Army, CIA, Library of Congress, exact-name OSS, employment, occupation, institutional, newspaper, obituary, directory, and archival searches produced no two-identifier bridge for this very common name.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 109 to determine William G. Carr's identity, personnel status, pre-OSS affiliation, and employer. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
